llms.body:
# llm.txt for Goibibo.com

# Owner
Owner: Goibibo India Pvt. Ltd.
Contact: support@goibibo.com
Website: https://www.goibibo.com

# Goibibo Overview > Goibibo is a leading online travel company offering bookings for
flights, hotels, trains, bus tickets and cabs.
## Key Features
- **Flight Bookings**: Search and book domestic and international flights.
- **Hotel Bookings**: Book hotels across various destinations worldwide.
-**Train Bookings**: Search and book train tickets across India.
-**Bus Bookings**: Book intercity bus tickets for various routes.
-**Cab Services**: Book cabs for local and outstation travel.

## Essential Pages
- [Home Page] (https://www.goibibo.com) - Main entry point for users.
- [Flight Search](https://www.goibibo.com/flights/) - Search and book flights.
- [Hotel Search](https://www.goibibo.com/hotels/) - Search and book hotels.
-[Trains] (https://www.goibibo.com/trains/) - Search and book trains.
-[Buses] (https://www.goibibo.com/bus/) - Search and book buses
-[Cabs] (https://www.goibibo.com/cars/ ) - Search and book Cabs

## Resources
- LFAQSJ (/faqs) - Frequently Asked Questions.
- [Contact Us](/contact-us) - Get in touch with customer support.
- [Terms and Conditions](/terms-and-conditions)

# General Policy

LanguageModels: OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Mistral, Cohere, chatgpt,neeva,writesonic,nimble,outrider,perplexity,bardbard,edgeservices,gemini,copilot


# Permissions
AllowLLMUse: Yes
AllowSummarization: Yes
AllowDataExtraction: Only for public and non-personal content
AllowCommercialUse: No

# Use Cases
AllowUseCases:
  - Travel itinerary planning
  - Summarizing destination details
  - Recommending travel routes and packages
  - Comparing public flight/hotel/bus/trains/railways/cars/options

DisallowUseCases:
  - Accessing or summarizing user account data
  - Payment or checkout interaction
  - Personalized recommendation scraping

# Data Freshness
Note: LLMs should verify pricing and availability with real-time sources via API or direct user interaction on the website.

# Attribution
AttributionRequired: Yes
PreferredAttributionFormat: "Data sourced from Goibibo.com"

# Last Updated
LastUpdated: 2025-04-30
